name: Hunt the Savages
summary: In the Hinterlands, Huntsman Markhor sends you to hunt savage owlbeasts. He asks you to bring down twenty.

sections.title: Claws and Beaks
sections.body: Huntsman Markhor warns that savage owlbeasts are among the Hinterlands' most ornery creatures. Their claws and beaks have cost Revantusk many good warriors. He wants every owlbeast you see killed, until you can bear no more bloodshed. Then he will weigh and judge your contribution. Twenty must fall.

sections.title: Clearing the Mind
sections.body: Markhor counsels you to clear your mind of unclean thoughts and join with the wild. Savage owlbeasts roam the Hinterlands wilds.

sections.title: Markhor's Judgment
sections.body: After the hunt, Huntsman Markhor names you a worthy friend to the Revantusk.

faq.answer: Huntsman Markhor, a huntsman from the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, offers the hunt.

faq.q: Why does Markhor want the savage owlbeasts killed?
faq.answer: Markhor calls savage owlbeasts ornery. Their claws and beaks have cost Revantusk many good warriors.

faq.q: Where can the savage owlbeasts be found?
faq.answer: Markhor says savage owlbeasts roam the Hinterlands wilds.

faq.q: How many savage owlbeasts must be slain?

attribution: Classic quest text: Hunt the Savages
